stem: Which syndrome is most commonly associated with congenital cataracts?
explanation: Down syndrome is the most common syndrome associated with congenital cataracts.
rationale: The key association being tested is the syndrome most commonly linked with congenital cataracts.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because Down syndrome is the most common syndrome associated with congenital cataracts.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Edwards syndrome is not the most common syndromic association with congenital cataracts.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because Turner syndrome is not classically the most common syndrome linked to congenital cataracts.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because Marfan syndrome is more associated with ectopia lentis than congenital cataracts.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because Noonan syndrome is not the most common syndrome associated with congenital cataracts.
